summary: Cite both verses of the combined quotation
rationale: The viziers’ speech “aw wazire əmmi … Hano mu qamoyo … d nayəḥlux ebe” is at 75/343. The final clause “mšawəš u malko” is at 75/344. The existing reference covers only the latter; replacing it by 75/343 alone would lose that clause’s reference.
